name: Eburwin the Headman
ac_note: hide armor + shield (one hand: shield strapped to the stump)
notes: Village headman. 50s, one hand, ex-auxiliary (25 years, no citizenship). Leads the spears when the village turns hostile. Spear +4, 1d8+2.
gm_notes: Hostile village (party kept the spear). Wants the box out past the house-posts. Will accept blood-price (20 denarii / weapon / tax relief under Lucius's seal) or a hearth-post oath that the box leaves at noon. Fights to drive off, not kill; with 6 Tribal Warriors, flees at half numbers.
objective: Get the box and the Romans out past the house-posts.
goal: End it without a Roman dying in his street (Rome would send the levy for every boy left).
agenda: Blocks the street with six spears; takes blood-price if offered.
secret: He paid the chieftains three cattle to keep the village safe the spring Wulf vanished, and has wondered ever since what they bought.
